declarations.description:
Animated text for a hero line or a status: words that rotate, a typewriter, characters that unscramble, a light that
sweeps across the text, or words that rise into place.

The text is the element's own text content, or the list in `words` for `rotate` and `typewriter` (`;`-separated or a
JSON array). `rotate` reserves the width of its widest word, so the line never jumps. `play` starts it on load, the
first time it scrolls into view, or on hover; `loop` repeats an effect that otherwise plays once (`typewriter` with
one text, `scramble`, `reveal`), and `replay()` starts it again. `effect-end` fires when a one-shot effect finishes.

Timings are CSS variables: how long a word stays (`--c2-text-effect--interval`), how fast characters type or resolve
(`--c2-text-effect__char--duration`), the shimmer's sweep and the reveal's stagger. `--c2-text-effect__text--background`
with a transparent `--c2-text-effect__text--color` fills the text with a gradient, for any effect.

Assistive technology reads the still text, never the animation: the full text, or the words joined with commas. It
is not a live region. Under reduced motion the effect shows its final state at once, and nothing animates while it is
off screen or the page is hidden.
declarations.name: TextEffect

cssProperties.description: How long each word stays, and the pause before a loop repeats.
cssProperties.name: --c2-text-effect--interval

cssProperties.description: How long a word takes to slide in and out.
cssProperties.name: --c2-text-effect__rotate--duration

cssProperties.description: Where a word narrower than the widest sits: `start`, `center` or `end`.
cssProperties.name: --c2-text-effect__rotate--align

cssProperties.description: How long each word takes to rise in.
cssProperties.name: --c2-text-effect__reveal--duration

cssProperties.description: The text colour; `transparent` with a background fill shows the fill.
cssProperties.name: --c2-text-effect__text--color

cssProperties.description: A fill clipped to the text, such as a gradient.
cssProperties.name: --c2-text-effect__text--background

slots.description: The text to animate, when `words` is not set.

members.name: words
members.description: The words `rotate` cycles through and `typewriter` types in turn. Replaces the text content when set.

members.name: play
members.description: When the effect starts: `load`, `in-view` (the first time it is seen) or `hover`.

members.name: loop
members.description: Repeats an effect that otherwise plays once.

members.name: ready
members.description: Whether the effect has taken over from the plain text (after the first update, so hydration matches the server).

members.name: text
members.description: The text read from the light DOM.

members.name: index
members.description: `rotate`: the shown word and the one leaving.

members.name: shown
members.description: `typewriter` and `scramble`: how many characters are shown or resolved.

members.name: noise
members.description: `scramble`: the glyphs drawn for the unresolved characters.

members.name: run
members.description: `reveal`: bumped to restart the CSS animation.

members.name: started
members.description: Whether the effect has started: an in-view effect waits to be seen, a hover effect rests on its text.

members.name: items
members.description: The texts the effect runs through: `words`, else the text content.

members.name: replay
members.description: Starts the effect again from the beginning.

members.name: toggleAttributeState
members.description: Pauses the CSS animations (shimmer) while unseen.

members.name: schedule
members.description: Schedules `step` after `ms`, waiting while the effect cannot be seen.

members.name: renderAccessible
members.description: What assistive technology reads: the still text.

members.name: restClass
members.description: Before it starts, an in-view effect waits unseen and a hover effect rests on its final text.

events.name: effect-end
events.description: Fired when an effect that plays once has finished. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: words
attributes.description: The words `rotate` cycles through and `typewriter` types in turn. Replaces the text content when set.
